The [[Mekuun Corporation/Legends|Mekuun Corporation]] '''Heavy Tracker''' was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Combat Assault Vehicle]] used as mobile surveillance and communications center by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Hvytracker.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Top view of the Heavy Tracker]]
The [[Mekuun Corporation/Legends|Mekuun Corporation]] Heavy Tracker was a 22.2 [[Meter/Legends|meter]] long [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicle. It had a top speed of one hundred and thirty [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]], and a ground clearance of two meters.<ref name="RASB2" /> Heavy Trackers were equipped with an [[Omniprobe sensor array/Legends|omniprobe sensor array]],<ref name="RASB" /> a standard military-grade [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] array,<ref name="RECG" /> and integrated long-range [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] to detect enemy forces and then relay that information to front line combat units. The omniprobe conducted low-level scans tied to a [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Gravity/Legends|gravitational]] center, with the [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] beam following the terrain which allowed it to detect enemy units without requiring line-of-sight.<ref name="RASB" />

The Heavy Tracker was a heavily armored craft armed with a single<ref name="RASB" /> [[Mk 2e/W heavy laser cannon]]<ref name="MBC" /> The cannon was fed data acquired by the omniprobe, allowing it to fire at selected targets from long range.<ref name="RASB" /> A crew of six operated the craft, two of whom were the [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]] assigned to man the heavy laser cannon, although it could be run by a crew of three individuals if needed. Five additional crew operated the omniprobe;<ref name="RASB2" /> two communications [[Technician/Legends|technicians]], two [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] technicians, and the [[Commander/Legends|commander]].<ref name="SaBP" /> It could carry two hundred and fifty [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]] of cargo, and consumables to last a [[Standard week/Legends|week]].<ref name="RASB2" /> Heavy Trackers cost 125,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to buy new, and 75,000 used.<ref name="RECG" />

==History==
The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] classified the Heavy Tracker as a [[Combat Assault Vehicle]], but utilized them as mobile scanning units rather than direct assault craft. Due to the vehicle's large target profile, slow speed, and long-range targeting capabilities, Heavy Trackers were kept behind the front lines since they had no reason to enter close combat situations.<ref name="RASB" />
